stem.text: Inside a cell, a damaged mitochondrion can be surrounded and enclosed by a membrane to form a vesicle.
What happens after the fusion of a lysosome with the vesicle?

A.text: ATP production by the mitochondrion increases.

B.text: Enzymes from the lysosome repair the mitochondrion.

C.text: Hydrolytic enzymes catalyse the breakdown of the mitochondrion.

D.text: The mitochondrion is released from the cell by exocytosis.
